children: RNS Number : 8529B  Scottish American Investment Co PLC  04 November 2026
The Scottish American Investment Company P.L.C. (SAIN)

The Board of SAINTS announces that it is declaring a third interim dividend of 4.15p per ordinary share in respect of the year to 31 December 2026.  This represents an increase of 5.1% on the corresponding dividend last year, which is above the latest reading of UK consumer price inflation (CPI) at 3.6%.  The dividend is payable on 11 December 2026 to shareholders on the register at the close of business on 13 November 2026. The ex-dividend date is 12 November 2026.  The Company operates a Dividend Reinvestment Plan and the final date for elections for reinvestment of this dividend is 20 November 2026.
The Board continues to expect dividends to grow ahead of inflation over the long term.
